title: Mall World Video Games?
content: Well this is interesting... This year two games were released: *Escape the Mall*, a table-top role playing game released by DNGN Club in January 2025, and *Escape: Mall,* a PC game released just a few weeks ago on Steam in October 2025. Apparently this genre of "escape from a mall" horror game is a thing, I'd just never heard of it until now. I just find the timing interesting giving that thousands of people are finding this sub and talking about this phenomenon now.
